name: Atos Les Clayes-sous-Bois global datacenter
notes: Atos and Yvelines departmental council inaugurated an energy-efficient datacenter in Les Clayes-sous-Bois on 2018-12-18. DCD reported first two prefabricated modules totaling 1,300 sq m, PUE 1.2, with six more modules planned by 2020; MW capacity not disclosed.

name: Telehouse TH3 Paris Magny / Magny 2 campus
notes: Telehouse's official TH3 page lists the Magny-les-Hameaux site at 1 rue Pablo Picasso in Yvelines, with about 66,000 sq m of site area. Its Magny 2 page describes five buildings, 12,000 sq m IT surface and 18 MW total electrical power. Le Parisien reported on 2026-05-31 a EUR250m ongoing expansion/new AI-ready high-density wing at the site.

name: Thésée DataCenter 1 Aubergenville
notes: Thésée lists DataCenter 1 at 32 rue du Clos Reine, 78410 Aubergenville. DCmag reported the first Tier IV-certified Aubergenville data center has 3 MW and has been operational since 2021; Groupe IDEC said the first building was commissioned/handed over in June 2021.

name: Thésée DataCenter 2 Voisins-le-Bretonneux / Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines
notes: Thésée lists Data Center 2 at 146 Avenue Joseph Kessel, 78960 Voisins-le-Bretonneux. DCmag reported Thésée began operating a second data center near Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines in 2021 under an HPE service agreement for a major French automotive industrial customer; MW capacity not disclosed.

name: Thésée Aubergenville 50 MW campus expansion
notes: Thésée's company page says it is developing a 50 MW Aubergenville campus in Yvelines with seven buildings and modules of 5-10 MW. DCmag reported construction of the new campus/first stage on 2025-11-19. DCD separately reported secured land for a further 33 MW IT capacity across six buildings at Aubergenville.

name: NDC Paris 1 / NDC Vélizy
notes: Altarea's project page lists NDC Paris 1 in Vélizy-Villacoublay (78) as 'Travaux en cours', delivery 2027, 2,268 sq m IT surface and 7 MW IT target power. Altarea also announced a building permit for a 7 MW IT Vélizy data center on 2025-11-17; NDC's site says delivery is in H2 2027.

name: Goodman Trappes-Élancourt data center on former Stellantis/industrial land
notes: La Gazette Eco reported Goodman France was selected for a next-generation data center on a consolidated 15 ha Trappes-Élancourt industrial site, citing 300 MW and nearly 34,000 sq m for servers. SQY planning materials corroborate the Copernic, Einstein and Iveco land assembly but capacity/developer details rely on local press.

name: SFR Trappes cloud datacenter
notes: 2014 trade press reported SFR would build a second cloud datacenter in Trappes, Yvelines, intended to open in January 2015, with HP leading project delivery and 12 MW reserved from EDF. No later operational confirmation was found during this pass, so current status is marked unknown.

name: Mérantais / Hilti sector data center, Magny-les-Hameaux
notes: Yvelines departmental opinion on the SQY PLUi project declaration for the Mérantais site in Magny-les-Hameaux states phase 1 would restructure the Hilti sector through demolition of the existing building and construction of a data center plus an economic-activity building. Capacity and developer not disclosed.

name: dc2scale Paris-Vélizy PAR2
notes: dc2scale's official page lists PAR2 at its Paris-Vélizy campus in Inovel Parc Nord, Vélizy-Villacoublay, with 250 sq m total surface, 56 racks and 240 kVA electrical capacity.

name: dc2scale Paris-Vélizy PAR3
notes: dc2scale's official PAR3 page lists the site in Inovel Parc Nord, Vélizy-Villacoublay, with 1,500 sq m total surface, 200 racks and 1.5 MVA electrical capacity; page also states two 1.5 MW electrical connections.

name: dc2scale Paris-Vélizy PAR5
notes: dc2scale's official PAR5 page lists the site in Inovel Parc Nord, Vélizy-Villacoublay, with 1,500 sq m total surface, 120-bay capacity and 1.5 MVA electrical capacity.

name: ETIX Paris #3 Vélizy
notes: ETIX's official Paris data centers page identifies ETIX Paris #3 at 16-18 Av. de l'Europe, 78140 Vélizy-Villacoublay, with 4,400 kW and 800 racks; ETIX describes the Paris sites as operational interconnected Tier III-equivalent data centers.

name: Fiducial Paris Data Center Vélizy
notes: DatacenterMap lists Fiducial Paris Data Center at 45 avenue de l'Europe, Vélizy, with 2 MW fully built-out power and 1,000 sq m whitespace, estimated 2011. Source is an aggregate listing, not primary.
